keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Angers 0, Nice 1. Sofiane Diop (Nice) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Mohammed Amoura.
Delay in match (Angers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Alidu Seidu (Nice).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Carlens Arcus (Angers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ousmane Camara (Angers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Angers 0, Nice 1.
Substitution, Nice. Xavier Mandza replaces Mohamed Abdelmonem.
Second Half begins Angers 0, Nice 1.
Substitution, Angers. Harouna Djibirin replaces Jim Allevinah.
Branco van den Boomen (Angers) is shown the yellow card.
keyEvents.shortText: Branco van den Boomen Yellow Car

keyEvents.text: Sofiane Diop (Nice) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Nice. Gauthier Hein replaces Sofiane Diop.
Substitution, Nice. Axel Witsel replaces Djibril Coulibaly.
Goal! Angers 0, Nice 2. Jonathan Clauss (Nice) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the top right corner. Assisted by Gauthier Hein.
Substitution, Nice. Nathan Ngoumou replaces Elye Wahi.
Substitution, Angers. Anthony Bermont replaces Branco van den Boomen.
Substitution, Angers. Lilian Raolisoa replaces Carlens Arcus.
Substitution, Angers. Usman Simbakoli replaces Prosper Peter.
Substitution, Nice. Morgan Sanson replaces Hicham Boudaoui because of an injury.
Substitution, Angers. Louis Mouton replaces Yassin Belkhdim.
